text:
- **Codex parity:** A Codex session now gets the same pm guarantees as a Claude Code session. A Codex-only machine keeps every guarantee, because the judge and day summary run on Codex.
- **Automatic releases:** Releases now ship from CI on each releasing merge, with no manual step. pm upgrade now prints the steps of every release it crosses and prunes unused launcher pins.
- **Design gates and CI access:** pm action need and pm sprint close hold changes to covered code until the design page is updated or waived. A PR run confirmed that GitHub Actions can call the Anthropic API through workload identity federation.
- **Session feedback:** The owner chose a session-end feedback ask over a Stop-hook ask. Work on a SessionEnd hook that starts a feedback run is now open.
